title: AI Benchmarks: design direction
question: Choose the design you want to build. Each mockup uses real benchmark names; the finished graphs will use verified source data.

options.label: The benchmark index
options.thesis: A precise benchmark index around one generous, inspectable plot.
options.viewport: A 220px benchmark rail, wide score/cost graph, compact result ledger below.
options.risk: The index needs a compact mobile form to leave enough room for the graph.

raised.raise: Numeric readings keep a deliberate scale relationship across axes and result rows.
The selected benchmark alone owns the central reading field.
Chart alignment and source conditions stay stable as benchmarks change.
One graph owns the field, with a compact and consistently placed identifier.
Every provider keeps a stable color and a text label through the whole app.

options.label: The research plate
options.thesis: A luminous research canvas with the comparison chart as the main event.
options.viewport: A compact headline, horizontal benchmark tabs, large chart, source notes on the right.
options.risk: Familiar research-dashboard structure; precision has to carry the identity.

options.label: The measurement desk
options.thesis: A dark instrument surface with fine luminous data and visible evidence.
options.viewport: A slim benchmark rail opens a very large dark chart with readings in an aligned band.
options.case: Strong product clarity through consistent calibration; audience identification is less immediate.
options.risk: Fine rules and dark axes need extra care for legibility.

options.label: Bitmap specimen
options.thesis: A benchmark specimen with repeated large numeric readings.
options.viewport: A comparison chart remains the core content.
options.case: Less immediate reading and weaker association with trustworthy comparison.
options.risk: Pixel lettering can hinder precise data reading.

options.label: Streaming wall
options.thesis: Benchmarks presented as expandable rows of plots.
options.viewport: A comparison chart remains the core content.
options.case: Hides comparison context and suggests browsing entertainment.
options.kept: One active plot receives clear visual priority.

options.label: Registered folio
options.viewport: A comparison chart remains the core content.
options.case: Seasonal metaphor adds little clarity for unrelated benchmark units.
options.risk: False continuity between incompatible benchmark scales.

options.label: Catalog sleeve
options.thesis: A numbered index with a single plotted field.
options.viewport: A comparison chart remains the core content.
options.case: Coded names obstruct model selection and do not help this task.
options.kept: One dominant plotting field and stable identifiers.
options.risk: Catalog numbers are less clear than benchmark names.

options.label: Transit mural
options.thesis: Provider lines and effort stops on a navigation map.
options.viewport: A comparison chart remains the core content.
options.case: Route angles would distort real chart geometry and weaken precision.
options.kept: Stable provider identity paired with labels.
options.risk: Transit geometry cannot replace true score/cost coordinates.

canonCard.label: The familiar dashboard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional benchmark dashboard executed with precise charts and controls.
canonCard.viewport: Top navigation, horizontal tabs, chart card and a results table.
canonCard.risk: Looks like other analytics apps by design.
